blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR) has elevated wildfire prevention to maximum alert status nationwide as the onset of a “Very Strong” El Niño triggers extreme heat and severe vegetation drying across grasslands and forests. Environment Secretary Juan Miguel “Mitch” Cuna said regional offices have rolled out comprehensive interventions—including total park closures, fireline construction, and continuous foot patrols—to protect critical ecosystems from escalating fire threats. “Our decision to deploy dedicated Bantay Gubat patrols and build firelines in high priority areas reflects our firm commitment to prevent wildfires.
